translation: From this I know that when a person has the disease of coughing, it is because the tip of the accumulation pricks and obstructs the lung tube; and when it lasts long and one spits blood, it is because the accumulation has grown large and burst the lung tube, so the blood is bright red. If the accumulation disperses and grows in balance, the blood stops and one heals; otherwise one vomits greatly. Extending to dysphagia (噎嗝), the accumulation forms strips and lumps that squeeze and block the food pipe; the yang aspect opens and the yin aspect closes; is this not caused by the accumulation? The rest of my diseases can be inferred by analogy, but still it is the reason of yin and yang not being harmonious.
